text: Photorealistic present-day documentary still, reconstructed from a licensed reference photograph. Keep the real landform, silhouette and proportions of the reference; change only season, light, weather and clutter as instructed. Natural lighting, neutral grade, realistic materials. Present-day surroundings (paths, trees, distant town) allowed only as they exist in the reference. No fantasy. No invented buildings. No text. No logos. No oversaturation. No glossy AI look. No malformed anatomy.
source: PHOTO_AI_STANDARD §2 A4 · D-035 #1 (present-day photo-based reconstruction; historical GLOBAL_V01 bans modern objects, which present-day shots need)
